title: feat: add Eleven v4 Turbo speech
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo`: ElevenLabs `api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}`, upstream `eleven_v4_turbo`, no aliases, paid-only, 1× multiplier, no Pollinations GPU. Supports simple speech, OpenAI-compatible speech, and timestamps.
- Includes #16581 and should merge after it. Both models use the same v4-family condition and parameterized test suite; removes the duplicate Turbo test file. CI covers Unicode usage, supported settings, and FLAC rejection for both models.
- Uses the current [official launch rate](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing/api), $0.011/1K characters, with no automatic expiry. Provider rate changes require an explicit registry update; the advertised regular rate is $0.04/1K.
- Keeps fallback **none**. Researched fal `elevenlabs/tts/eleven-v4-turbo`: direct probe passed, but fallback billing remains unverified. Account concurrency limit is 15; three concurrent misses passed.
- Validation: 93 focused Gen tests, 479 Enter tests, Gen/Enter typechecks, and six live tests across both models covering 35 voices, five formats, all endpoints, cache, and disconnect/rejoin. Provider analytics confirm 63 Unicode characters cost $0.000693; wallet and staging Tinybird agree. The Turbo rejoin produced one $0.009856 debit/event. Live tests run separately from credential-free CI.

gist.headline: Another voice in the garden
gist.blurb: Eleven v4 Turbo joins the speech lineup, with timestamps for anyone who likes their words and audio to arrive together. Polli is taking notes.
gist.summary: Adds paid-only `elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo` for simple and OpenAI-compatible speech and timestamped output, priced at $0.011 per 1,000 characters with a 1× multiplier.
gist.impact: Developers get a new ElevenLabs voice model across all three speech paths, including timestamps, with usage billed at $0.011 per 1,000 characters.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Eleven v4 Turbo as a cozy retro speech terminal sending a waveform alongside neatly aligned timestamp markers. Polli, wearing tiny headphones, listens beside the terminal; lime-green code-plants and flowers connect the audio feature to the pollinations garden.
